messages:
chris (IC): Quick question 3 rehired after a temporary layoff (came back within 8 months). Do I keep my 401(k) vesting and employer match eligibility, or do I start over? Also any impact on HSA employer contributions for the year?

donna (People Ops): Short version: depends on plan rehire rules. Many plans treat service breaks under 12 months as continuous service for vesting. Marta can confirm our plan specifics.

marta (Benefits): Confirmed: our plan has a 12-month rehire rule for service credit. Since you were rehired within 8 months, your prior service counts for vesting. Match eligibility is tied to payroll contributions after rehire; we won't retroactively create match for missed pay periods while you were gone.

chris (IC): So vesting preserved, but if I had contributions before layoff and none during the layoff, do I lose employer match for those missed months?

marta (Benefits): Correct: employer match only applies to actual contributions posted. If no contributions were taken during the layoff, there is nothing to match for those pay periods. We can discuss catch-up contributions if you want to increase deferral for remaining months.

ryan (Payroll): For HSA employer contributions: we contribute a prorated annual employer contribution based on eligible pay periods. If you missed pay periods while on unpaid layoff, your HSA employer contribution for the plan year will be prorated. We can calculate exact amount for your case.

chris (IC): If I want to make up missed match, can I voluntarily increase deferral to catch up and get employer match on extra contributions?

marta (Benefits): You can increase your deferral but employer match is calculated per-pay-period contribution up to plan limits. Increasing deferral later doesn't retroactively create match for earlier missed payrolls. However, higher contributions after return will be matched going forward.

hr-bot: Ticket HR-REHIRE-2026-11 created to calculate proration for HSA + provide catch-up options. Please expect a Benefits email with numbers within 3 business days.

donna (People Ops): Action items: Marta to send proration calc to Chris; Ryan to confirm payroll records for layoff dates; Chris to decide if he wants to increase deferral for remainder of year. We'll update handbook FAQ: "Rehire under 12 months: service credit preserved; matches only for actual contributions; HSA employer contribution prorated."
